fixture_setup: supabase/schema.sql (Release 1-4 tables, R3 standard roles) and supabase/seed.sql (Release 1 data). Release 4 company fixtures are served unchanged at https://immxrsive-platform.vercel.app/fixtures/r4/{company_normal,company_sparse,company_prompt_injection,company_same_name_other_domain}.html. collaboration_seed.json entries were entered through the staff screens. Release 3 demo fixtures are under /demos/.
test_access: Students/visitors: testers sign in with their own GitHub account and verify their own @algomau.ca email at /student. Staff: the same kind of account, then /staff and the staff access code supplied privately (instructor QA email thread). 'Turn off staff tools' on /staff returns the account to an ordinary student. No shared passwords.
